senses.gloss: to be clear, bright, transparent.—Part. זָיֵג, זָיֵיג.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 74b:5">Pes. 74ᵇ</cite> <he>דזיג וכ׳</he> ed. (Ar. <he>דזייג</he>) it was as clear as &c., v. <cite ref="G00061"><he>זְגוּגִיתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 134a:13">Sabb. 134ᵃ</cite> <he>והיכא דז׳</he> and where there is a transparent spot in the child’s rump.
<cite ref="Chullin 76b:1">Ḥull. 76ᵇ</cite> <he>כיון דזִיגֵי וכ׳</he> (Ar. <he>דזייגי</he>) when they are transparent although not white.
Keth. 61ᵇ זָג לה she got a greenish bilious complexion (was swollen, Rashi).
